title: 5D triple
description: A triple (spec/SPEC.md §11): (s, p, o, dimension, weight, provenance) plus an OPTIONAL grammar_id, exactly one dimension per edge. Mirrors five_d_nd/triple.py's triple_violations() exactly. 's'/'p'/'o' are non-empty strings; 'dimension' is one of the five (never absent); 'weight' is a JSON number (never a boolean) in [0, 1], defaulting to 1.0 when absent (the schema itself does not apply this default — it only requires the field's TYPE when present); 'provenance' is required to be PRESENT, with no further shape constraint (an nD grammar's own provenance model, e.g. factual's SourceTag, is out of this schema's scope, matching §6's own looseness); 'grammar_id' names which nD grammar produced this triple, a non-empty string when present.
